tagGroups.title: Tag groups

mode.label: Tags per card
mode.hintSingle: Choosing another tag of the group replaces the previous one.
mode.hintMulti: No limit: a card can carry as many as you want.
mode.hintLimited: A card can carry up to that many tags of the group.

tagGroups.intro: A tag group is an ordered set of tags. Sort a list by a group to rank cards by their best tag in it, or split a list into one category per tag.
tagGroups.name: Group name
tagGroups.deleteConfirm: Delete the tag group "{{name}}"? Tags and cards are not affected.
tagGroups.orderHint: Order matters: the first tag ranks first. A tag can belong to several groups.
tagGroups.noTags: This group has no tags yet.
tagGroups.scopeTeam: These groups belong to the whole team: every board, the server queries (rank()) and the AI use them.
tagGroups.scopeLocal: Local workspace: these groups only exist on this device.

listView.sortIntro: Sorting is only a view: the order you set by dragging is kept.
listView.allHidden: All {{count}} cards are hidden by filters.

categories.intro: Categories split this list into labelled sections. Each card goes to the first category it matches; the others go under "Rest".
categories.name: Category name
categories.errorsHint: Fix the highlighted conditions: they match nothing for now.
categories.restName: Name of the remaining cards section
categories.showRest: Show cards that match no category
categories.visualNote: Categories are visual: cards keep their list, and dragging between lists works as usual.
